sources.title: 己內醯胺 (CPL) — 中國石油化學工業開發股份有限公司
sources.locator: Product description: “己內醯胺為產製尼龍6纖維和樹脂之重要原料”
sources.note: Official issuer product disclosure supports CPL as an important raw material, not expressly as the sole raw material.

sources.title: BASF realigns caprolactam production in Europe
sources.locator: Release states: “Caprolactam is the starting material for the plastic polyamide 6”; also describes BASF polyamide 6 products for fibers.
sources.note: Supports the starting-material relationship, but does not say caprolactam is the only raw material for Nylon 6 fibers.

sources.title: 尼龍粒 (CHIP) — 中國石油化學工業開發股份有限公司
sources.locator: Product description: “尼龍粒為己內醯胺的下游衍生物”; it identifies both fiber nylon chips and engineering-plastic-grade nylon chips.
sources.note: Official issuer disclosure supports CPL as an upstream precursor to these nylon products, but does not establish exclusivity.

sources.title: BASF realigns caprolactam production in Europe
sources.locator: Release states caprolactam is the starting material for PA6 and describes BASF’s PA6 value chain through engineering plastics.
sources.note: Supports the precursor relationship, not the assertion that caprolactam is the sole raw material.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused research found relevant official issuer and manufacturer disclosures for the CPL-to-PA6 relationship, but none resolved the exclusivity wording. The unresolved atoms remain UNKNOWN rather than treating absence of an exclusivity statement as evidence against the claim.
The original wording omits the subject; CPL is inferred from the issuer’s product context.
The official issuer pages describe CPL as an “important” raw material and nylon chips as its downstream derivatives, not as the sole raw material.
The BASF release uses “starting material,” which does not establish exclusivity.
